method: Identity-reduced A/B/C comparison using only cutoff-available operating metrics: direct AIDC monetization/growth, earnings quality, valuation/expectation baseline and exposure specificity. Company names/tickers were ignored for the ranking step.
result: The profile with >5亿元 H1 data-center revenue, ~461% YoY growth, ~16% revenue share and expanding power-module product breadth ranked above a profile with data-center capacity still ramping and H1 profit down ~41%, and above a high-quality grid-equipment exporter with less direct AIDC-specific revenue evidence.
caveats: The model may still encode company identity/outcomes in its parameters.
Live search result pages exposed some post-cutoff snippets before lock; those snippets are excluded from evidence but cannot be unseen.
Passing this masking check does not convert the run into clean historical validation.
